grep -n "^#" README.md; git add -A && git status --short && git commit -q -m "fix: sanitize issue titles and bodies, and allow comments after extension specs" -m "- The title and body of the issue or pull request (also for pr_number runs) now go through sanitizeInput(), like the trigger text, so HTML comments and invisible characters can't hide instructions there.

Refs #32" && git push -q origin docs/32-documentation-cleanup 2>&1 | tail -1; git log --oneline -3
